faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)
faq.description: Find answers to commonly asked questions about our products and services
faq.contactDescription: Our team is ready to help. Reach us on WhatsApp or email.
faq.waMessage: Hello, I would like to ask about Etira mushroom products

items.q: What product variants does Etira Mushroom offer?
items.a: We offer mushrooms in several variants: fresh, pouch, canned, and frozen. Each is available whole or sliced, depending on your needs.

items.q: How do I prepare pouch or canned mushrooms?
items.a: The mushrooms are packed in a light brine to preserve them and are ready to cook. Simply drain, rinse briefly if needed, then stir-fry or add them directly to soup, pasta, pizza, or your favorite dishes.

items.q: How long do fresh mushrooms last?
items.a: Fresh mushrooms keep for 5–7 days refrigerated at 2–4°C. For optimal freshness we recommend using them within 3 days. For longer storage, our canned and frozen products last over 2 years.

items.q: How are quality and freshness maintained?
items.a: Our mushrooms are grown in modern climate-controlled facilities at 1,850 masl near Mount Bromo. Processing and packaging happen the same day as harvest to preserve maximum freshness, under international HACCP sterilization standards.

items.q: Are the products safe and legally registered?
items.a: Yes. Etira Mushroom products are processed sterilely to international standards and hold official BPOM and MUI Halal certifications. Every batch passes strict quality control at each production stage.

Button mushrooms suit diet menus: low in calories, high in fiber, and rich in protein, vitamin D, and natural antioxidants. Their firm, meaty texture also makes them a common meat substitute in vegetarian cooking.

items.q: How do I place an order for my business?
items.a: B2B orders go straight through this catalog: pick your products, set the volume, then confirm on WhatsApp. Our team prepares the invoice and schedules the delivery. Retail packs are also available through authorized resellers on marketplaces.

Prices shown in the catalog are B2B supply prices per unit with a stated minimum order. Tiered pricing is available for larger volumes; contact our team for a quote based on your commodities and supply schedule.

items.q: What should I do if there is an issue with my delivery?
items.a: Contact our customer service as soon as the goods arrive, including your order or invoice number and product photos as documentation. Our operations team will follow it up with you.

Yes. We run a dedicated service for restaurants, hotels, catering, and other food businesses, with wholesale pricing, scheduled recurring deliveries, and product consultation tailored to your menu needs.

tentang.title: About Company
tentang.subtitle: Profile, quality dedication, and production facilities of PT Eka Timur Raya (Etira Mushrooms)
tentang.producerTitle: Leading Modern Mushroom Producer in Indonesia
tentang.historyDescription1: Established in 1999 and rooted in the slopes of Mount Bromo (Nongkojajar), PT Eka Timur Raya (Etira Mushrooms) has operated for more than 25 years as one of the pioneers of integrated button mushroom cultivation and processing in Indonesia.
tentang.historyDescription2: We combine precision climate-controlled farm systems with HACCP-certified sterile processing lines to produce high-quality fresh mushrooms, canned sterile, pouch retort, and frozen preparations for a network of hotels, restaurants, catering, and national F&B industries.
tentang.visionMissionSubtitle: Foundation of our commitment to provide the best food supply for our partners
tentang.visionText: To be a global pioneer in providing high-quality, healthy, safe, and sustainable mushrooms for families and the food industry.
tentang.visionDescription: We are committed to leading the mushroom horticultural supply chain by applying sustainable agricultural technology and integrated processing efficiency.
tentang.visionBullet1: Pioneer in environmentally friendly and integrated mushroom cultivation
tentang.visionBullet2: Provider of high-nutrition food raw material supplies
tentang.missionText: Committed to producing products with the highest quality standards to ensure customer satisfaction and full supply reliability for business partners.
tentang.missionDescription: Our operational focus is built on food integrity, distribution speed, and certainty of supply volume to support partner needs.
tentang.missionBullet1: Apply international HACCP & Halal sterilization standards
tentang.missionBullet2: Ensure cold chain refrigeration to maintain harvest freshness
tentang.advantagesSubtitle: Why hundreds of culinary and HoReCa industry partners trust their supplies to Etira
tentang.advantage1Desc: Ensures consistent stock availability without supply fluctuations for restaurant chains and processing facilities.
tentang.advantage2Desc: Processed with regular hygiene laboratory tests, passes hotel food safety audits and export market requirements.
tentang.advantage3Desc: Support for custom formulation, custom cuts (whole/sliced), and branded packaging for your brand.
tentang.advantage4Desc: Supported by temperature-controlled refrigerated fleet to maintain freshness of commodities directly from factory.
tentang.facilitiesIntro: Our factory and cultivation garden in Purwodadi, Pasuruan - approximately 65 km from Surabaya - is strategically located with direct access to Java logistics arteries and Tanjung Perak port.
tentang.facilityBudidayaDesc: Climate and humidity-controlled growing houses with automatic systems for precision harvest cycles.
tentang.facilityKalengDesc: High-pressure autoclave and retort equipment to HACCP standards for 2+ year shelf life.
tentang.facilityColdStorageDesc: Large-capacity freezer warehouse with dedicated truck refrigeration docking.
tentang.facilityOlahanDesc: Processing of value-added products such as mushroom nuggets, meatballs, and vegetable patties.
